svg.text: Single-clock phase generator | one flat transistor/passive cell | CLK_PHASE_FLAT_V3
Existing qualified gate drawings are expanded inline. These panels create no schematic or layout subcells.
One CLK_IN; static six x ten-bit words; EVAL/CAPTURE/PHASE. Shared supply only, no added delay-bias current.
